48654.summary: The class examines Jesus' triumphant entry into Jerusalem, focusing on Zechariah 9:9 and John 12, emphasizing Jesus as the prophesied king and Passover lamb. It highlights Israel's rejection of Jesus and contrasts it with the significance of his entry as a fulfillment of prophecy and a personal challenge to accept him as the sacrificial lamb.

48655.summary: The class discusses Jesus' triumphant entry into Jerusalem, focusing on the symbolism of the ass and the vine, and the fulfillment of prophecy. It also covers Judas' betrayal and the significance of the 30 pieces of silver, emphasizing the themes of atonement and resurrection.
